oil.when: 2021 Cherokee with the oil change indicator (cluster menu method)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and put the ignition in ON/RUN without starting the engine.
Use the steering wheel arrow buttons to go to Vehicle Info in the cluster display, then to the Oil Life screen.
Press and hold OK until the oil life gauge goes back to 100%.
Start the engine. If the oil change message shows again, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: The manual also gives a backup method: ignition in ON/RUN with the engine off and your foot off the brake, slowly push the accelerator fully to the floor three times within ten seconds, then switch the ignition off.
